_note: Operator-maintained price table for scripts/daily_paper_run.py. USD per 1M tokens. The library ships no built-in prices on purpose (#582) - these values are NOT authoritative. VERIFY THEM against your provider's current price list before the first live run, and re-check whenever you switch models. Over-estimating is the safe direction: the budget then trips early instead of late. A model with no entry here is billed at the most expensive configured rate, so keeping the priciest model listed keeps that fallback conservative.
